title: They’re On Dantooine
caption: They’re On Dantooine (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Dantooine sites are immune to No Escape. At Dantooine sites, your Force generation is +1. While you control a Dantooine site, your squadrons may deploy without replacement for X Force, where X = squadron’s power -3. May not be canceled. {alter}
lore: “You would prefer another target? A military target? Then name the system!”

notes: Printed base is a UTINNI EFFECT; the slip banner says EFFECT. Non-unique (no dot). Title apostrophe typed as curly ’ as the slip prints it (wiki page title uses a straight '). Printed lore is in double curly quotes (wiki stub uses single quotes). Both wiki scans are 350 px: used the -decipher-archive printed face; ANH-L-theyreondantooine.gif (also downloaded) carries an 'E' errata label. No modern 'Virtual Set N' remake found (no 'They're On Dantooine (V)' page), modern=null.
